description_en: Retrieves the ssl certificate details for a cluster
name: ListSSLDetails

CustomCert.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate is a custom certificate (`true`) or was generated by the system (`false`)
CustomCert.description_zh: 系统自动生成的证书固定为 false；用户上传自定义证书时固定为 true

IsValid.description_en: Indicates whether the certificate is valid

IssuerDN.description_en: The Distinguished Name (DN) of the certificate's issuer. For a system-generated certificate, this value matches the `SubjectDN`. For a custom certificate, it identifies the Certificate Authority (CA) that issued the certificate
IssuerDN.description_zh: 系统自签名证书时，因为是自签名，IssuerDN 和 SubjectDN 内容相同（自己签自己）。用户自定义证书时，取 x509Cert.getIssuerDN().getName()，指向实际签发该证书的 CA 机构
IssuerDN.example: CN=fe-sr-cn-xxx123-internal.starrocks.aliyuncs.com, OU=Aliyun Big Data Platform EMR StarRocks, O=Aliyun, L=BJ, ST=CN, C=CN

NotAfter.description_en: The end time of the certificate's validity period
NotAfter.description_zh: 证书有效期的截止时间

NotBefore.description_en: The start time of the certificate's validity period
NotBefore.description_zh: 证书有效期的开始时间

SslCertificateText.description_en: The Base64-encoded content of the certificate file in PKCS#12 (.p12) format. For a system-generated certificate, this is the content of the generated file. For a custom certificate, this is the content that was provided during upload
SslCertificateText.description_zh: 存储的是证书文件的 Base64 编码内容（PKCS#12 格式的 .p12 文件）。系统证书是生成的 P12 文件 Base64 后的字符串；自定义证书则是用户上传时传入的 customSSLCertificate 原始值

Status.description_en:
The status of the certificate. Valid values:

valid

expired

unknown
Status.description_zh:
状态列表。

valid

expired

unknown

SubjectDN.description_en:
The subject's Distinguished Name (DN), which includes the following information:

C: The country code where the organization is located.

O: The name of the organization.

OU: The department within the organization.

L: The city where the organization is located.

CN: The common name or abbreviation of the organization
SubjectDN.description_zh:
CA证书的DN（Distinguished Name）属性，表示证书的使用者，具体包含以下信息：

C：组织机构所在国家代码。
O：组织机构的名称。
OU：组织机构下的部门。
L：组织机构所在城市。
CN：组织机构的通用名称或简称
SubjectDN.example: CN=fe-{clusterId}-internal.starrocks.aliyuncs.com, OU=Aliyun Big Data Platform EMR StarRocks, O=Aliyun, L=BJ, ST=CN, C=CN

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the request was successful
